name: Chef
description: Cook's Utensils: You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils. Replenishing Meal: As part of a Short Rest, you can cook special food for up to 4 + your Proficiency Bonus creatures; each ally who spends Hit Dice to heal during the rest regains an extra 1d8 HP. Bolstering Treats: With 1 hour of work (or when you finish a Long Rest), you can cook treats equal to your Proficiency Bonus; a creature can eat one as a Bonus Action to gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
